My story is quite peculiar and might be hated by sales people. I am into
selling content and courses for data science which is an area which requires
perseverance from customers to make it till end.  More sales was never a
metric for me. The right metric was to get more students who can complete
course and make a successful career transition. Great patience is required to
sell to 60% of my leads and about 20% need slight nudge - one call or so and
rest 20%, pay right away after reviewing our content, reviews, policy. The
best thing i did was to ignore 60% of leads, to convert whom, we needed extra
resources - money + people. So I stopped investing in such costs - landing
pages, website, SEO, sales and marketing etc and used the same amount to
subsidize the course for rest 40% people. We make course content which sells
for itself. We provide free demos, free course reviews, 15 days refund etc and
spend very little time in followups to 60% leads. We achieved good results on
our metrics. Our completion rates are very high at 80% much greater than
market average of 40% All our patience goes in creating kick-ass content,
revise, re revise content and mentoring 40% leads. Only one followup to our
leads !! Strictly !!  (edited)
